AnyValue.description: Any JSON value but null, at any depth: what an object may hold of a property that this version of the format does not define, which a consumer ignores (PRD §6.4).

BoardId.description: A board's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Counts.description: How many of each entity the snapshot holds.

nodes.description: The nodes of every type: elements, branches, and jumpers.

variables.description: The variables, global and of each board.

DraftSnapshot.description: The working draft, as it was when it was pulled, which has neither an ID nor a version (PRD §7.8).

contentHash.description: The hash of the draft's content when it was pulled, as a release's is computed (PRD §7.3).

Entry.description: Where the flow starts: a node, and its board.

name.description: What wrote the snapshot, storycreep for the server.

Hash.description: sha256: and the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the bytes.

Manifest.description: A snapshot's manifest, storycreep.json: what the snapshot is, its boards, and the hash of each of its files (PRD §6.3, §6.5).

astVersion.description: The highest ast_version among the constructs that the snapshot's expressions use, 1 for none (FR-EXPR-04). A runtime that supports a lower one refuses the snapshot (PRD §6.4).

boards.description: Every board, sorted by ID, by which a runtime finds a board's file without reading any other board's (PRD §6.5).

entry.description: Where the flow starts: the project's entry node, of its entry board. Without it, the project has none.

files.description: The hash of each of the snapshot's files but the manifest, by its path, which uses forward slashes.

schemaVersion.description: The version of the published format, 2.

ManifestBoard.description: A board of the manifest's index: its ID, slug, name, entry node, and file.

entryNodeId.description: The board's entry node, where the flow enters the board when it starts there. Without it, the board has none.

file.description: The path of the board's file, boards/ and its slug and .json, which the manifest's files list too.

NodeId.description: A node's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

ProjectId.description: A project's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

contentHash.description: The hash of the snapshot's content: the SHA-256 of a line of each of its files but the manifest, in the order of their paths, of its path, a space, its hash as files holds it, and a line feed (PRD §7.3).

note.description: The note that the release was published with.

version.description: The release's version, which its author chose.

Snapshot.description: What the snapshot is: a published release, or the working draft as it was when it was pulled, which its channel tells (PRD §7.8).

SnapshotId.description: A snapshot's ID, in its canonical spelling (PRD §5.2).

Timestamp.description: A moment, in UTC, to the second (RFC 3339), as 2026-10-12T18:04:31Z.

description: A snapshot's manifest, storycreep.json, at the root of the snapshot's files (PRD §6.3, §6.5). This is the test-only synthetic version 2 of the format, which only test builds read; testdata/synthetic-schema/README.md describes it.
title: Storycreep published format, synthetic version 2: storycreep.json
